hook: Food safety raid: *40 kg* spoilt fish dumped at Ramnagar market
hook_b: Food safety raid: *40 kg* spoilt fish dumped at Ramnagar market
tldr: TG SAFE's Food Wing inspected fish markets in Begum Bazaar and Ramnagar on Nov 27, checking hygiene, storage and food safety compliance.

beats.what: Vendors violating food safety norms were issued notices; two Ramnagar establishments got closure notices and 40 kg of spoilt fish was discarded.
beats.why: The drive aims to stop the sale of spoiled or unsafe fish and ensure hygienic seafood for buyers.
beats.care: If you buy fish at these markets, check freshness; violators have been told to comply with prescribed norms.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Officials checked sanitation, storage conditions and compliance at fish vending units.

cards.q: Where do you usually buy fish?

qs: How often are city fish markets inspected?
What happens to a vendor after a closure notice?

facts.t: *2* markets covered in the Nov 27 drive: Begum Bazaar and Ramnagar.

viz.verdict: Enforcement step for buyers' safety; vendors must fix storage.

learn.t: TG SAFE = Telangana Standards Authority for Food and Essential Drugs, the state's food and drug safety regulator.

watch: Whether the drive extends to other fish markets.
